subject: Make .graph node filenames Windows-safe (colon codec + migration script)
description:
PROBLEM: .graph/nodes/ contains ~410 files named with a colon (note:note-XXXX.jsonl, system:repos.jsonl). Windows forbids `:` in filenames, so `git clone`/`checkout` of this repo fails on Windows. The colon originates in lib/graph-store.js canonicalEventNodeId() ('note:'+id) and from system: node ids; it is written straight into the filename by appendEvent. lib/graph-store.js is the ONLY file that builds/parses node filenames (appendEvent writes; loadGraph + compact read).

DELIVERABLES (on the attempt branch only — do NOT run a bulk rename of live data on the branch; the daemon is writing those files concurrently):
1. lib/graph-store.js — add a Windows-safe filename codec, keeping in-memory node IDs (with `:`) unchanged so all edges/checkpoint refs still resolve:
   - idToFile(id) => encode ONLY `:` as `%3A`, append `.jsonl`. Do NOT encode `/` (it is an intentional subdir separator for keys like `followup/...`, `bench/...`).
   - fileToId(relPath) => strip `.jsonl`; normalize Windows backslash separators to `/` (split on /[\\/]/, join '/'); decode `%3A`->`:`. Legacy `:` filenames already decode to `:`, so reads stay backward-compatible (handle BOTH old `:` and new `%3A` on disk).
   - Use idToFile(canonicalEventNodeId(nodeId)) for the appendEvent dest path.
   - In loadGraph, derive rawId via fileToId(file) instead of file.slice(0,-6); keep the existing /^note-.../ canonicalization after.
   - In compact, build the liveFiles set with fileToId(f) and delete with idToFile(n.id).
2. test/ — add a small round-trip unit test: idToFile/fileToId for `note:note-abc`, `system:repos`, a plain numeric id `12`, and a subdir id `followup/harness-judge-drain` (round-trips with `/` preserved, `:`->`%3A`->`:`). Match the existing test runner/style in test/.
3. scripts/migrate-graph-filenames.js — idempotent one-shot that renames existing colon files in .graph/nodes/ to their %3A form. Prefer `git mv` when the file is tracked (so the rename is recorded), else fs.renameSync. Skip files already in %3A form. Log a count. This script is REVIEWED here but RUN later by the dispatcher at daemon-restart time — the worker must NOT execute the bulk rename.

VERIFY: round-trip test passes; existing graph-store tests still pass. Keep the change surgical — no refactors beyond the codec.
